signal: BluIP announced an expanded UCaaS + CCaaS go-to-market partnership with NiCE in June 2026, integrating its Cloud PBX with NiCE CXone

email.body1:
Nancy, saw BluIP expanded its go-to-market partnership with NiCE, tying Cloud PBX into CXone.

New co-sell motions create buying signals faster than most ops teams can route them, so good-fit accounts sit untouched and the data goes stale. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every touch auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for BluIP off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nancy, quick follow-up for BluIP.

Most RevOps leaders know the lift is hiding in faster signal-to-action and cleaner follow-up, but it is hard to see exactly where the process leaks. Our built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change to tighten the signal-to-meeting path.
email.body3:
Nancy, last bit of proof for BluIP.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BluIP's reply rate likely compares to other cloud-communications vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nancy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Wiring up a new co-sell motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to BluIP either way.
